description: Use when you need structured, machine-readable facts rather than prose: give a Wikidata ID (Q95) or a name (resolved to the best-matching item) and get its label, description, aliases, Wikipedia link and up to ~50 curated properties with human-readable labels: instance of, country, location, coordinates, inception/dissolution, official website, headquarters, industry, employees, revenue, stock exchange and ticker, LEI, parent and subsidiaries, population, area, capital, currency, languages, time zone, ISO codes, software license/version/repository, and more. Entities that are individual people are refused (non-personal data only). Paid tool: x402 USDC on Base, $0.002 per successful call; call without payment to receive the PaymentRequired object.

id.description: Wikidata item ID, e.g. Q95 (Google). Give id or q.

q.description: Name to look up, e.g. "Cloudflare" or "Vilnius". Give id or q.

name: entity
